News.Title: TOU Mega Chujowe Extension v1.0.0
Text: ★ <link=https://github.com/HekerB/TownOfUsMegaChujoweExtension/releases>Download Latest Release</link> ★ <link=https://github.com/HekerB/TownOfUsMegaChujoweExtension>GitHub Repository</link> ★
Version 1.0.0 is finally here!
<size=105%>Crewmate:</size>
- Vanisher - fixed bug where players were unable to use the Vanish button
- Falcon - replaced zoom in/out button icons with a single one
- Bodyguard - added sacrifice animation in meetings, fixed being able to kill the protected player, improved shield and nameplate marker rendering
- Evoker - fixed inability to click map/tasks/doors during blind and fixed global verification limit per game not being respected
- Vampire Hunter - fixed incorrectly granting crewmate power and protective
- President - definitive fix for vote bank system, added tutorial image, fixed banner visibility
<size=105%>Neutral:</size>
- Pelican - complete rework: added swallow counter, fixed Investigator footprints, fixed huge range, fixed anti-cheat kicks during digestion, restored UI refresh after death, fixed instant ghost bug
- Doppelganger - fixed kill button cooldown not decreasing while in vents
- Shroud - fixed marker visibility and placement logic
- Lawyer - reworked Objection: now shows your own character, added sound fade-out, fixed client marker visibility
- Pirate - added tutorial image, fixed ties counting as win, fixed button blocking during duel
- Bounty Hunter - added target counter, fixed target marker refresh and visibility bug
- Pope - fixed win condition, added Spellslinger death animation, fixed screen flashing during meetings, added marker visibility
- Shifter - fixed Assassin modifier exploit for Amnesiacs
<size=105%>Impostor:</size>
- Kamikaze - fixed kill detection, reworked explosion radius to use RC-XD light scaling, changed sphere color to orange, added round 1 suicide protection
- Wraith - fixed lantern visibility bug and added a small delay to ensure Swooper modifier applies before teleporting
- Poisoner - added poison body animation, fixed poisoned players not dying in meetings
- Witch - fixed curse marker rendering and visibility
- Outlaw - fixed kill button
- RC-XD - improved car rendering and sync, fixed body/shield/target marker persistence
<size=105%>Modifiers & Mechanics:</size>
- Death Note - fixed numerous bugs and improved overall stability
- Guessing System - Venomous and Death Note are now guessable based on their individual toggles
- Lovers - added toggle option for Lover Chat during meetings
<size=105%>Game Modes & UI:</size>

- Draft Mode - complete system overhaul with polished UI, added Random Neutral (70/15/15 logic), added Legacy Mode (picking from all classes) and Respect Role Chances, fixed spectators being included in pick order
- Localization - added Full Polish Support with Local Settings toggle
- Lobby Options - significant reorganization and rework of many option groups
<size=105%>Other:</size>
- Wiki Overhaul - added detailed terminology with new icons (Lawyer, Medic, Jackal, Shield Flashes)
- Wiki Settings - added Hacker icon and real-time display for Draft Mode
- Fixed Crewmate abilities (Evoker, Falcon, Mirage, etc.) not working during communications sabotage
- Cleaned up redundant RPC calls and improved Host-side synchronization
- Optimized mod size (36MB -> 14MB)
- Most importantly: fixed old bugs and added new ones!

Version 1.0.1 - Vulture & Draft Overhaul
<size=105%>Vulture Updates:</size>
- Robust Eating - Fixed body eating RPC system for maximum reliability
- Fade Effect - Added Body Cleaning Duration option for a smooth fade-out effect
- Streamlined Logic - Removed mandatory stand-near-body duration for a faster experience
- Intro Sound - Changed intro sound to Chef's
- Visual Feedback - Added color-coded screen flash on body detection
- Progress Counter - Eat button shows (Eaten/Total) progress
- Custom Vent - Replaced vent icon with Werewolf Vent
- Vitals Fix - Fixed compatibility with Mira API's vitals system
<size=105%>Draft Mode & Wraith Updates:</size>
- Instant Start - Draft now triggers immediately, skipping Among Us countdown
- UI Polish - Improved animations (selection punch, glow, glint) and fixed layer depth
- Draft Commands - Added /draft start and /draft cancel commands with chat alerts
- Safety Measures - Blocked nickname changes during active draft sessions
- Wraith Vision - Fixed lantern visibility logic (blocked by walls/shadows)
- Internal - Fixed CI/CD pipeline and restored missing dependencies
